book.name: Macho
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Macho gɛ̀ saŋ

content: Kune kinche ki woŋ bɛ jɛ yi Nyo
Bafalashii bɛ bamii bamu ba gɛ̀ duunyi banchi ba Nyo gɛ̀ ja Yɛlusalɛm bo to fɛ Jiso le bo biih wu le lɛ,
“Le nje la wù booŋ buŋ ba ŋgoo chɛŋe bɛ kinche ki woŋ ki bachiji besa ba fweele? Gɛ bo chuge chiaaŋ a je yì nchi goone le, fɛ bo jii mwɛɛ gɛ.”
Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Le nje la wù bɛŋ ŋgode fiena banchi ba Nyo, bɛŋ bii nyu kinche kena ki woŋ le?
Njɛme nɛ, nje Nyo le wu du lɛ, ‘Ŋgvuuŋ chijo bɛ bwoo.’ Wu ka wu du tɛ lɛ, ‘Nɛ muh naŋ lo chiji kɛnɛ bwee, ba yuuyɛ lo mwɛdɛ.’

Geenɛ, bɛŋ tu bɛŋ duu fiena lɛ, ‘Nɛ muh ja wu jɛme chiji le kɛnɛ bwee le lɛ, “Fiɛɛ fì wo bee wo kɛme chiaaŋ yaŋ le nnya wa Nyo le”, tu gɛ taŋlo bɛŋ ka bɛŋ jo fiɛɛ fiyu bɛŋ fih chiji wene yu kɛnɛ bwee wene yu gɛ.’
Le nɛ no bɛŋ bii kinche kena ki woŋ le bɛŋ gee jɛ yi Nyo tuu fiɛɛ fì achiji.
Bamii ba jɛme yeye bo gee yeye banɛ. Fiɛɛ fì muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo wù Yosaya gɛ̀ jɛme kune bɛŋ le nchiɛɛŋ, no wu gɛ̀ jɛmɛ lɛ,
‘Bamii banɛ ŋgvuune mɛ gɛh fɛmu fɛmu,
muntele muboo nyu je yì ndefe le fɛ mɛne.
Bo yuuse mɛ nyu achiji,
nje bo jode mwɛɛ mù bamii kwaji bo yɛyi lɛ le jɛ yaŋ.’”

content: Fiɛɛ fì taŋlo fi chɛŋɛ bɛ muh
Jiso ja wu tɛɛŋ bamii bo to. Wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû, bɛŋ kɛ̂ɛ chuule.
Gɛ fiɛɛ fì lese a muh mu taŋlo fi yiisɛ wu gɛ. Le fiɛɛ fì bude lo a muh mu fì taŋlo fi yiisɛ wu.”

content: Booŋ ba Jiso ba ŋgoo ja bo to bo jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Wo kee gɛ lɛ Bafalashii be bo yu fiɛɛ fì wo be jɛme fiɛɛ fì gwe fɛ fitele fiboo le?”
Wu chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Kite kichii kì le njɛ yile chii wù le fɛwe sɛŋ ba lé ba bâa.
Bɛŋ daayɛ a bo le, le binfeeŋ bì duunyi je bamii le. Nɛ kinfeeŋ duunyi je kimi le, tu bo bachii lé bo gɛ̂ɛŋ bo gwe a kintuge le.”

content: Bita jɛmɛ Jiso le lɛ, “Gɛh yuusɛ bee fiɛɛ fì ŋgaŋ wɛɛ jɛme.”
Jiso biih lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ bɛŋ tɛ kee mwɛɛ gɛ?
Gɛ bɛŋ kee lɛ fiɛɛ fichii fì lese a muh mu boge a shɛŋ fi ge fi fe fi bu lo gɛ?
Geenɛ, fiɛɛ fì bude jwe wu muh le jade nyu fɛ fitele le. Le fi fì yiise muh.

Fi jade nyu fɛ fitele le fɛ muh kɛme ŋkwajɛ wù befe, ki muh yu muh, ki muh jo kwɛ muh kɛnɛ juma muh, muh jaŋ kinjaŋ, ki muh choŋ bvuchoŋ, ki muh bɛɛ jiŋ yi nsa wu chimbiaŋ, kɛnɛ ki muh chɛŋɛ bɛ jee chi muh.
Munɛ le mwɛɛ mù taŋlo mu yiisɛ muh. Gɛ ki muh ji bɛ chiaaŋ njɛ wu chugɛ sɛŋ taŋlo fi yiisɛ muh gɛ.”

content: Kwɛse wumu wù gɛ̀ bee ntolo leesɛ fitele yi Jiso le
Jiso ja fo wu kɛŋsɛ yo wu gɛɛŋ kimbe ki Taya bɛ Sidoŋ le.
Fi kooshɛ lɛ kwɛse wumu wu Kanan wù gɛ̀ bee yo gɛ̀ ja wu to wu yɛŋ Jiso le, wu bee fɛ wu le lɛ, “O Tada, mwa Nfoŋ Dabi, koo yii fɛ mɛne. Mwa yaŋ wù kwɛse le nchɛndaa wu debele fiinɛ bɛ wu baaŋ.”
Geenɛ Jiso yu wu gɛ ghaa lo gɛ. Booŋ be ba ŋgoo kɛŋsɛ bo to bo lɛgɛ wu bo jɛmɛ lɛ, “Du kwɛse wunɛ le lɛ wu gɛ̂ɛne. Wu bii wu nyaa njiɛɛsɛ bee le.”
Jiso chvuu lɛ,

content.text: “Ba gɛ̀ tuŋ mɛ nyu fɛ bamii ba Ishwala le maa ba le njɛ shóŋ yi ja wa yi lɛsɛ lo.”

content: Geenɛ kwɛse wɛɛ ja gɛh wu to wu tuŋ anyuu a Jiso jii wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Tada, fih gɛh mɛ.”
Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ fi nyu chuule ki jo ŋgu yi booŋ noŋ bvú le gɛ.”

content: Kwɛse wuyu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Le nchiɛɛŋ chii. Geenɛ bvú to yi boonyi munchvuge mu chiji bo sege wu jii mu gweeyi.”
Jiso mo wu chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “O kwɛse wunɛ, mbɛmɛ wo tɛɛme lo. Fi kooshɛ fɛ wo le no wo goone.”

content: Gɛh noo mwa ye mo wu tɛmɛ.
Jiso nyaŋɛ bamii banchvuge banɛh
Jiso gɛ̀ ja fo wu gɛɛne, wu fede mbebe Mamasi wu Galalee le, bo bɛɛŋ bo gɛɛŋ yi mbegɛ le, wu shii fo.

Kinchvu kì bamii ki baaŋ to fɛ wu le nɛ gɛmm. Bamu gɛ̀ too bɛ bamii ba le batɛŋlaase, mo ba le biŋkɛlɛ, mo ba le binfeeŋ, mo ba le binchifɛ, mo bamu ba chɛne wesee. No bo too bɛ bo, bo gɛɛde a wu jii wu fɛde bo.
Kinchvu kiyu tu ki kɛme lo kimaŋe no bo gɛ̀ yɛde binchifɛ jɛme, bamii ba le biŋkɛlɛ tɛɛme, batɛŋlaase jiɛnyi tɛ chaaŋ, binfeeŋ yɛde mwɛɛ le. Bo tu bo tume maŋkuŋ ma Nyo wu bamii ba Ishwala.
Jiso tɛɛŋ booŋ be ba ŋgoo wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Ŋkɛme yii fɛ kinchvu kinɛ le, nje bo le wa besa bo aju atade, fiɛɛ fì bo ji nyume gɛ yu gɛ. Gɛ ŋkoŋe lɛ nchinɛ bo le bo gɛɛne jɛŋ gɛ, nje taŋlo bo gɛɛŋ bo gwe jɛŋ aje.”

content: Booŋ be ba ŋgoo jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Taŋlo besabɛŋ jo faaŋ mwɛɛ munjile nchvuuŋ kfunɛ mù kojɛ ki ba nyaŋɛ kfuu chi kinchvu ki bamii kinɛ yu?”
Jiso biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ kɛme chefe yi blɛd yimiɛɛ?”

content: Bo chvuu lɛ, “Le bvusooshwi bɛ bíɛŋ nɛ shige.”
Jiso mo wu du lɛ kinchvu ki bamii kiyu shii fɛkuu
Bo shiiyɛ, wu jo chefe yi blɛd yi bvusooshwi chiɛɛ mo bíɛŋ chiɛɛ, wu nya kiyone Nyo le, wu bwɛɛyɛ wu nya booŋ be ba ŋgoo le, bo gajɛ bamii bayu le.
Muh wuchii ji, wu fuu. Bo baanyɛ bimbɛge bì gɛ̀ shɛshɛ, bi yisɛ ŋkáa bvusooshwi.
Bamii ba gɛ̀ ji gɛ̀ bee bilɛŋsɛ banchvuge banɛh, fɛ nyu bikɛse bɛ booŋ.
Wu mo wu chinɛ kinchvu kiyu le ki kwɛɛde. Wu lee a ŋguh le wu gɛɛŋ kimbe ki Magadaŋ le.
